description: Focus timer that saves what you worked on. Run pomodoro, countdown and interval timers in a live card, plan focus blocks into a time window, and review your focus history.

interface.longDescription: PomoDial is a focus timer built around one habit: say what you're working on before the clock starts. Ask for a 25/5 or 50/10 pomodoro, a countdown, or a work/rest interval timer, and a live timer card appears in the conversation with the PomoDial dial, the current block and its intention, what's next, and Start, Pause, Skip and Reset buttons. Plan a session from a time window, such as "I have 3 hours until 5pm", and PomoDial fits whole focus blocks around your breaks with clock times and a calendar file. Every session is saved to your PomoDial account, so you can ask what you got done this week and see your intentions, streaks and total focus time. Built-in skills help you plan revision for an exam, run flashcard and language review sprints, write a thesis or report in timed sprints, wrap up sessions, review your week, and log focused time per client.
defaultPrompt: Plan Pomodoros to revise for my biology exam from 2 to 6pm
